p5_b0.ocr: The table presents a comprehensive analysis of various inflammatory markers and fatty acid profiles in relation to hepatitis E virus (HEV) infection, specifically focusing on data collected at 28 days post-infection (dpi). The metrics of interest include C- reactive protein (CRP) and interleukin-6 (IL-6), both of which are pivotal indicators of inflammatory response.

p5_b1.ocr: The correlation coefficients indicated for these markers suggest a significant relationship with the presence of HEV RNA, as evidenced by the positive-strand and negative-strand HEV RNA detection columns. Furthermore, the fatty acid composition, including omega-3 (n-3) and omega-6 (n-6) fatty acids, provides insight into the potential modulatory effects of dietary components on inflammatory pathways during viral infections.
